name: venviewer-trainer-cu132
readme:
Venviewer trainer — gsplat main @ 512d366b (1.6.0, unreleased) with NVIDIA PPISP v1.3.0 on PyTorch 2.14.1 + CUDA 13.2 Update 2 (every extension built by nvcc 13.2.86), for A100 80GB and H100 (D-016a, validated 16 Oct 2026). Needs a 580-series host driver or newer (CUDA minor-version compatibility). The image is not yet built or pushed; until it is, follow 'New environment on a plain RunPod image' in infra/runpod/RUNBOOK.md. Old recipes: omnitwin/trainer:1.5.3-cu124.

On boot:
  1. /opt/bootstrap.sh runs (decoded from CMD): pulls the trainer code from OMNITWIN_GIT_REPO @ OMNITWIN_GIT_REF, snapshots the git SHA/branch/remote into /workspace/code/.git_*, writes rclone.conf for R2, then exec's bash.
  2. Operator opens an SSH or web terminal into the pod.
  3. Operator runs /opt/verify_build.sh and confirms the JSON output (gsplat 1.6.0, torch 2.14.1+cu132, CUDA 13.2, the GPU visible).
  4. Operator runs /opt/run_training.sh with the desired flags per infra/runpod/RUNBOOK.md.

No persistent volume — R2 is the storage layer. Container disk 80GB covers one venue's colmap_v2 + depth priors + bundle output.

Do not enable spot/interruptible until run_training.sh checkpoint-resume has been validated end-to-end.
